sloka: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्य रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः ।शिरसा ऽ ऽवन्द्य धर्मात्मा वक्तुमेवोपचक्रमे ।। ६.१९.२३ ।।।।
transliteration: śrutvā tu vacanaṁ tasya rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ ।śirasā ' 'vandya dharmātmā vaktumevopacakrame ।। 6.19.23 ।।।।

translations.english: "I will render assistance with all my strength for storming Lanka, for killing the Rakshasas and for the army to enter."
